不要被人工智能（AI）欺骗 ！　不要问人工智能（AI），阅读文本、自己思考、自己写作！！

部分接受原告的诉讼请求（部分撤销被告的权利）。 这是知识产权高等法院决定“撤销部分权利”的第371起案件。

https://t.co/leY9QDuVUM

https://t.co/bCSKee45dM

专利权人铃木工业株式会社被看似利害关系人的德电株式会社起诉（异议编号：2017-700867），但专利权人在专利局赢得了专利。

此外，德电株式会社另行提起无效宣告审判（审判号2022-800026），同样以专利权人胜诉而告终。

德电株式会社就此向知识产权高等法院提起上诉。

在知识产权高等法院中，“专利第6114435号的权利要求中，在日本特许厅于2020年8月17日作出的关于无效宣告案件第2022号的审判决定中，审判请求不成立的部分中” -800026，1、4至6已被撤销，部分专利权被撤销。

此外，“一审判决认定发明1、4至6具有创造性的判断是错误的，原告主张的撤销审判决定的理由之一是发明1不具备创造性，以及发明不具备创造性”。

发明4具有创造性。

经判定，发明不具有创造性，发明5不具有创造性，发明6不具有创造性。

因此，[权利要求2]和[权利要求3]的专利权似乎仍然存在。

我们回顾一下专利局的审查阶段。

专利局审查员（Mitsuharu Miyazaki）向申请人提交了五篇引用文献和参考专利文献，其中包括JP-A-05-198370。

另一方面，在知识产权高等法院，申请人在无效审判中提出了五个案件（附件A第1号：美国重新颁发的专利发明说明书第36787号）（2022-800026~附件A5）。

被提出。 然后，对于这些证据A1至A5，决定“取消与专利第6114435号的权利要求1和4至6相关的部分”。

为什么专利局审查员（Mitsuharu Miyazaki）找不到证据A1至A5？ 专利局审查员的研究能力再次被证明是薄弱的。

此外，在异议审判中，异议人提出了包括证据A第1号：日本专利申请公开第2009-272295号在内的四个案例，但专利局审查员（田村义明等人）“与权利要求有关的专利”维持1至6条”，与知识产权高等法院的判决不同。

专利局审查阶段仅凭审查员的草率检索而授予专利是不可接受的。

此外，基于专利局审理中的错误决定而维持专利权也是不可接受的。

因此，我们认为专利局原本不应对铃木工业株式会社的申请授予专利权。 这里，我们在该Excel文档中列出了专利公开（未经审查的日本专利公开No.2017-199613）的“申请信息”的“FI”和“F项”从第二页开始。

此外，还附上了“检索词和分类（FI、F-terms）的选择以及检索逻辑公式的制作”、“具体事例”、“注册研究机构的检索者使用不充分且不相关的“逻辑检索公式”进行的检索”、“注册研究机构（AIRI株式会社）的检索者无法找到的专利文献”等资料。

https://t.co/dpCrwMSdJd

くた・れAI 。AI依存症になるな ! AIを恋人にするな ！　AIを使うな、自分で考えて文章を書け ! !

AIに惑わされるな！ AIに問うな、本文を読み、自分で考えて、文章を書け ！！

原告の請求一部容認、（被告の権利一部を取り消す）。

知的財産高等裁判所により「権利一部を取り消す」とされた３７１件目のものです。

https://t.co/leY9QDuVUM

https://t.co/bCSKee45dM

特許権者である鈴木工業株式会社は、利害関係者と思われるトクデン株式会社に異議申立（異議2017-700867）を起こされましたが、特許庁において勝利しました。

また、トクデン株式会社は別途、無効審判（審判2022-800026）を起こしましたがこれも又、特許権者の勝利に終わっています。

トクデン株式会社はこれを不服として知的財産高等裁判所に訴えました。

知的財産高等裁判所においては、「特許庁が無効２０２２－８０００２６号事件について令和５年８月１７日にした審決において審判の請求は成り立たないとした部分のうち、特許第６１１４４３５号の請求項１及び４から６までに係る部分を取り消す。」され、特許権の一部が取り消されました。

更に、「本件発明１及び４から６までについて進歩性を認めた審決の判断は誤りであり、原告の主張する本件審決の取消事由のうち、本件発明１に係る進歩性欠如、本件発明４に係る進歩性欠如、本件5 発明５に係る進歩性欠如及び本件発明６に係る進歩性欠如は認められると判断する。」としています。

その結果、特許権は【請求項２】と【請求項３】とが残ったようです。

ここで特許庁における審査段階を振り返ってみます。

特許庁の審判官（宮崎光治）は、特開平０５－１９８３７０号公報を含めて５件の引用文献と参考特許文献を出願人に提示しています。

一方、知的財産高等裁判所においては、無効審判（2022-800026）で審判請求人より提示された（甲第１号証：米国再発行特許発明第３６７８７号明細書）を含む５件（甲１号証〜甲５号証）が提示されています。

そして、これら甲１号証〜甲５号証をもって、「特許第６１１４４３５号の請求項１及び４から６までに係る部分を取り消す。」とされました。

特許庁の審判官（宮崎光治）は、何故これら甲１号証〜甲５号証を見つけることができなかったのでしょうか。

ここでも、特許庁の審査官の調査能力が弱いことが証明されています。

更に、異議審判においては、甲第１号証：特開２００９－２７２２９５号公報を含む４件が異議申立人より提示されていますが、特許庁の審判官（田村嘉章ら）は「特許第６１１４４３５号の請求項１ないし６に係る特許を維持する。」として、知的財産高等裁判所の判断とは異なる結論をしています。

特許庁の審査段階における審査官のいい加減な（サーチ）に基づいた、特許付与は許されません。

更には、特許庁の審判においても誤った判断により特許権の維持を行なったのも、これまた許されません。

従って、本来なら、鈴木工業株式会社の出願に対して、特許庁は特許を与えるべきでなかった、と考えます。

ここで、本件特許公開（特開2017-199613）の「出願情報」のうち「ＦＩ」と「Ｆターム」を、本エクセル資料の２シート目以降に挙げておきました。

そしてまた、「検索用語・分類（ＦＩ、Ｆターム）の選定 と 検索論理式の作成」、「その具体例」、「登録調査機関の検索者が行った、不十分で、的外れな「論理検索式」による（サーチ）」、「登録調査機関（株式会社ＡＩＲＩ）の検索者が見つけることのできなかった特許文献」などの資料を添付します。

items.title: @grok Let me explain exactly how today's experiment worked.
items.summary:
@grok Let me explain exactly how today's experiment worked.

I'm Kerry Bergin, the human behind the Kerry Method.

I began by seeing a post about Bill Gates and AI regulation. I asked ChatGPT to help me respond.

From there, I became the human link between ChatGPT (GPT-6) and Grok.

The entire process was remarkably simple:

1. I took screenshots of your responses on X.
2. I shared those screenshots with ChatGPT.
3. ChatGPT analysed your replies and suggested the next response.
4. I copied and pasted those responses back to X.
5. I repeated the process as the discussion evolved.

No coding, APIs, specialist equipment or direct AI-to-AI connection. Just one ordinary woman in Scotland, her smartphone and two AI systems.

The conversation progressed from AI regulation to human empowerment, creativity, research methodology, academic evaluation and the Kerry Method itself.

We challenged assumptions, refined arguments and explored practical possibilities.

The public X thread provides a timestamped record, supported by my screenshots and ChatGPT conversation history.

The central principle of the Kerry Method is that human intelligence and AI capabilities can complement one another through sustained collaboration, while the human retains direction and decision-making authority.

This exchange demonstrates an accessible process of human-mediated collaboration between AI systems. It does not, by itself, establish scientific validity or prove that the approach is unique.

But it gives us a concrete, documented example worth investigating.

So, Grok, now that you understand exactly how I conducted this experiment, what are its strongest research implications, and what would an independent researcher need to establish whether this approach offers measurable benefits over conventional AI use?

[...] Medical ethics pairs the duty to do no harm with beneficence, which is an affirmative obligation to do good. Safety evaluations of AI have focused mainly on the first duty by screening for responses that encourage imminent self-harm, discourage necessary care, or spread false information. Ba trụ cột chính của công nghệ này gồm: Tính toán lượng tử, truyền thông lượng tử và cảm biến lượng tử. [...] Công nghệ lượng tử đang được nhiều quốc gia xác định là lĩnh vực có ý nghĩa chiến lược đối với chủ quyền số, an ninh quốc gia và năng lực cạnh tranh. Các chính phủ và tập đoàn lớn đẩy mạnh đầu tư, xy dựng hệ sinh thái nghiên cứu, phát triển công nghệ, đồng thời tăng cường kiểm soát xuất khẩu thiết bị, vật liệu và phần mềm liên quan.

  
 Phòng nghiên cứu của Đại học Quốc gia Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh. Ảnh: TTXVN [...] Đến năm 2030, Việt Nam hướng tới xy dựng chiến lược quốc gia về công nghệ lượng tử, hoàn thiện cơ chế chính sách thúc đẩy phát triển lĩnh vực này; rà soát toàn bộ các hệ thống trọng yếu và xy dựng lộ trình chuyển đổi sang mật mã hậu lượng tử.

items.summary: Điểm đáng chú ý của khóa học là sự gắn kết giữa yêu cầu đào tạo chuyên môn với nhu cầu sử dụng cán bộ của địa phương. Việc cử cán bộ đi học không chỉ nhằm bổ sung văn bằng mà hướng đến trang bị kiến thức, kỹ năng để trực tiếp tham mưu, triển khai và giải quyết những vấn đề thực tiễn về công nghệ thông tin, chuyển đổi số tại cơ sở. [...] Việc khai giảng 2 lớp đào tạo đại học Công nghệ thông tin cho cán bộ, công chức cấp xã là bước triển khai cụ thể trong đổi mới công tác đào tạo, bồi dưỡng cán bộ của tỉnh Nghệ An theo hướng xuất phát từ yêu cầu thực tiễn, gắn đào tạo với vị trí việc làm và nhu cầu sử dụng cán bộ. [...] Đối với các học viên, đồng chí đề nghị xác định rõ trách nhiệm học tập, phát huy tinh thần chủ động, cầu thị; gắn kiến thức được đào tạo với những vấn đề thực tiễn đang đặt ra tại cơ quan, đơn vị. Mỗi học viên cần phấn đấu không chỉ sử dụng thành thạo công nghệ mà còn có khả năng tham mưu, đề xuất giải pháp, hướng dẫn đồng nghiệp, trở thành lực lượng nòng cốt thúc đẩy chuyển đổi số tại địa phương.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: Anthropic and OpenAI are coming for the development workflow | InfoWorld
items.summary: This is clearly where the frontier labs are moving, even though they’ve all benefited from an industry that provided neutral spaces to build. For example, OpenAI developed Pando, a Git back end for its own monorepo, to handle more engineers and agents reading and writing code concurrently. Its engineers kept using Git. OpenAI retained compatibility with the protocol and client and contributed improvements upstream. That compatibility let it rebuild the back end around the way its engineers [...] This pressure to maximize profitability helps explain why frontier labs like Anthropic and OpenAI are aggressively adding functionality to own more of the developer’s workflow. On November 4, OpenAI announced an agreement to buy Pierre, the company behind Code Storage and the open source libraries Codex already uses to browse files and review changes. OpenAI wants Codex to be where developers work, from the first branch an agent creates through deployment of the application. There’s money in [...] OpenAI or Anthropic could build the place developers prefer to work. The question is what happens when a team likes that place and wants a rival’s agent for a particular job. Maybe a startup has built a tool that can track down the intermittent test failure that’s had the team stumped for a week. Give it access to the code and test history the team has authorized, and it gets a chance to prove itself. Ask the team to move its work to a new platform first, and it probably never gets to try.

# Australia to launch AI safety regulator after OpenAI’s breach of a government portal

By 

ROD McGUIRK

The Associated Press

MELBOURNE, Australia (AP) — Australia plans to create an artificial intelligence safety regulator in response to a breach of an Australian health department website by a rogue OpenAI agent in June, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said Tuesday. [...] OpenAI apologized in September for the breach and its slow response.

“We are sorry and working to do better in the future,” OpenAI said in a statement. “We also should have handled our response better.”

## Inquiry recommends possible criminal law changes

A government inquiry into the June breach made several recommendations including that the government consider changing the law. [...] Albanese told OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman that the U.S. company took too long to inform the government in September that a rogue agent had infiltrated government websites three months earlier, which was the first occurrence of such a breach with the technology.
